objective: Improve sequence-based OrthoHMM accuracy without benchmark-label leakage, uncontrolled specificity loss, or unjustified runtime and memory growth.

accepted.evidence: Fresh OrthoBench F=70.4, precision=78.9, recall=63.5, 13 exact RefOGs; +6.6 F-score points over previous production but -2.3 points versus OrthoFinder 3.1.5.
accepted.cost: The independent fresh estimate is 2.25x standard wall time and 4.2x standard peak process-tree RSS.

accepted.change: Exclude self-hits before reciprocal-best threshold estimation
accepted.evidence: Recovered 1,803,122 RBNH edges and exactly reproduced historical final-cluster SHA-256 8ee100f4370fef6e3e6a3e0fd36112adcc3aefeb60197331115667c519ca121f.
Preserves byte-identical scientific output while bounding queued task payloads to twice the worker count.

already_implemented.implementation: Center-star MSA profiles estimate a position-specific frequency matrix, substitution-matrix pseudocounts, and per-position log-odds emissions.
Built-in Viterbi scores are normalized once by sqrt(query_length * target_length); E-values also include query length and target database size.
RBNH derives a per-gene threshold from reciprocal best hits across species; strict profile expansion uses each profile's weakest existing-member score.
Species-pair search adapts candidate capacity from k-mer coverage, and downstream weights are corrected using pairwise reciprocal-best-hit scores.
The native prefilter performs k-mer counting and diagonal support, then reranks candidates with substitution-matrix ungapped extension scores before HMM scoring.

rejected.experiment: Relax profile self-threshold or anchor requirements
rejected.result: Best comparable variant F=69.7 or lower versus F=70.4.
No factor beat the unmodified 1.00 boundary; factor 1.00 gave the best pre-profile F=69.8.
F-score fell from 70.4 to 70.2 while candidates doubled from 5,014,697 to 10,029,408 and replay wall time increased from about 319 to 721 seconds.
One species-pair screen lost 10,168 exact-alphabet significant pairs and added 2,073.

rejected.experiment: Reduced-alphabet fallback for exact no-hit queries
rejected.result: Rescued only 110 of 14,300 no-hit queries and 122 significant pairs in the screened species pair.

deferred.reason: Scores from different matrices are not directly calibrated; global BLOSUM45 regressed, so mixing matrices now risks uncontrolled decision-boundary shifts.
Current transitions are uniform. A defensible change requires transition estimation and held-out calibration, not hard-coded loop/core penalties.
Per-group score sets can be sparse and non-Gaussian. This requires a benchmark-independent calibration corpus and train/validation split before production use.
Requires a calibrated profile-pair alignment model and null distribution; the estimated 2-3x cost is unjustified without evidence beyond the current one-pass profile gain.
Adds confidence reporting rather than directly improving assignments and has approximately 100x profile-build cost at the proposed replicate count.

validation.recommendation: Keep high_sensitivity opt-in until fresh QfO scoring completes.
